en: Black‑and‑white image of two large detached villas on a grassy hillside, enclosed by wooden picket fences. The houses have a distinct Central European alpine or spa‑town style with steep hipped roofs, timber framing on the upper floors, shutters on the windows, and small balconies or glazed verandas. A dense coniferous forest rises behind the houses, while the foreground shows an open slope of grass. There is no visible printed caption or text on the image side.
